transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I just... haven't really been myself lately. I stopped doing things. I used to hike, coach... play some guitar. I don't really do any of that now. I don't call people back either. 

Some days I just... sit in my rental. For hours. I know there are things I should be doing, but... I just can't make myself start. So... I guess that's why I'm here.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or productive, to the point where you didn't need much sleep for several days at a time?
No... I don't think so. I don't really get bursts of energy like that. I just... no.
Did these changes in your mood and activity levels start shortly after a specific stressful event or life change?
Not really. I don't... nothing specific happened. It just sort of... got like this. I don't know.
Have you ever gone through a period like this before, perhaps months or years ago, or is this the first time you have ever felt this way?
No... I don't... I don't think so. I've never really... been like this before. It's just... lately.
How has your sleep been lately?
It's... fine. I sleep okay, I guess. I haven't really... noticed anything different. Just normal.
How long have you been feeling this way?
A while, I guess... maybe a year and two months. Since I moved. Into that smaller rental... after the divorce. Things just sort of... unraveled since then.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your weight since you started feeling this way?
No... not really. I just eat when I need to. My weight is... it hasn't changed. Just normal, I guess.
Do you often find yourself feeling down on yourself or thinking that you aren't good enough?
No... I don't think so. I just... do what I have to do. I don't really think about it like that.
Beyond the loss of interest in your hobbies, would you say that you generally feel sad or depressed most of the day, most days?
No... I wouldn't say sad. I don't really feel... depressed. I just... I just get through the day. That's all.
When you say you just 'get through the day,' would you describe your mood as feeling numb, empty, or indifferent to things around you?

I don't know about... numb. I just... I don't really feel like myself anymore. I stopped doing things. Hiking... coaching... playing my guitar. I don't really call anyone back either. 

Some days I just sit in my rental for hours. I know there's stuff I should be doing, but... I just can't make myself start.
